questions.q: How is Mean Decrease in Impurity (MDI) computed?
options: By shuffling each feature on held-out data and measuring the performance drop
From the training data alone, by summing how much each feature reduced impurity across all splits
By refitting the model once per feature with that feature removed
By correlating each feature directly with the target variable
questions.explain: MDI (scikit-learn's .feature_importances_) is computed in-sample from the training data, based on how much each feature reduced impurity whenever it was used as a split.

questions.q: Why is MDI specifically unreliable on typical financial feature sets, according to López de Prado's critique?
options: Financial datasets are usually too small to compute MDI at all
MDI only works for regression, not classification
Financial features are often correlated/substitute variables, and MDI's split-counting divides credit unevenly between them
MDI requires labeled data, which finance rarely has
questions.explain: Financial feature sets are full of redundant, correlated variables describing the same phenomenon. MDI's in-sample, split-counting logic handles this poorly, understating or distorting importance for substitute features.

questions.q: What does permutation importance actually measure?
options: The correlation between a feature and the model's residuals
How much held-out performance drops when one feature's values are randomly shuffled
The number of times a feature was used as a split across all trees
The variance of a feature across the training set
questions.explain: Permutation importance shuffles one feature's values (breaking its relationship with the target) and measures how much the model's out-of-sample performance degrades.

questions.q: Which property makes permutation importance more trustworthy than MDI for financial models?
options: It is computed out-of-sample and is model-agnostic
It runs faster than MDI in every case
It requires no held-out data at all
It is immune to correlated features
questions.explain: Permutation importance is measured against held-out performance (not training-data split counts) and works identically regardless of model type, making it harder to fool with in-sample overfitting.

questions.q: Mean Decrease Accuracy (MDA) is best described as:
options: A synonym for MDI with a different name
Permutation importance's shuffle-and-measure approach, applied across cross-validation folds and averaged
A metric that only applies to linear regression models
The accuracy of the model before any features are added
questions.explain: MDA applies the same shuffle-a-feature-and-measure-the-drop idea as permutation importance, but computes it across each fold of a cross-validation scheme and averages the result.
